 Portugal suffer injury scare as Rafael Leao limps out of Galatasaray win 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article According to Goal.com, Portugal have suffered an injury scare before their final Nations League group fixtures after Rafael Leao limped off during Galatasaray ’s 4-3 win over Amedspor on Saturday.
 The forward struck after seven minutes to give the hosts the lead, but was withdrawn in the 50th minute with discomfort. Okan Buruk replaced him with Deniz Gul, a recent arrival from Porto.
 OneFootball Videos
 The result kept Galatasaray top of the Super Lig, yet Leao’s early exit worried club and country. Speculation in Türkiye suggested the RAMS Park surface may have played a part in the non-contact issue, drawing criticism locally.
 Post-match, Leao sounded upbeat. He said he believed it was nothing serious, would undergo check-ups the next day, and that Galatasaray’s medical staff would handle his treatment during the international break. He added he felt calm.
 Even so, he accepted his involvement for Portugal in the upcoming window is uncertain. He also thanked team-mates for helping him settle and said he aims to become decisive once fully fit.
 Portugal are due to host Denmark in Braga, then travel to Wales to conclude their Nations League group. Further assessments will clarify the extent of the injury and whether he can feature.
 Source: Goal.com
